blocks.title: Commercial Engine
blocks.body: EVEN Hotels commercial distribution rides IHG One Rewards direct channels, GDS, OTAs, and parent sales systems. Wellness-forward select-service: fitness-centric public space, healthier F&B cues, and efficient rooms for travelers who prioritize wellbeing routines on the road. Owners should underwrite channel mix and loyalty contribution for this asset—not corporate averages alone.

blocks.title: Commercial Differentiator
blocks.body: Versus conventional select-service, EVEN sells wellness programming as the demand hook; versus full-service spa resorts, it keeps a tighter capital stack inside IHG One Rewards.

blocks.title: Owner Perception Risk
blocks.body: Owners sometimes expect lifestyle lightness without systems cost; EVEN Hotels still carries parent systems, IHG One Rewards economics, and brand QA. Align IC expectations early.

blocks.title: IHG One Rewards
blocks.body: EVEN Hotels participates in IHG One Rewards. Members earn and redeem points and receive Elite recognition across participating sister brands. Confirm current tier names and earn rules on the official program site before IC.

blocks.title: Loyalty
blocks.body: IHG One Rewards at EVEN Hotels

blocks.title: Earn
blocks.body: Guests earn IHG One Rewards points on qualifying stays at EVEN Hotels. Elite members may receive enhanced earn and recognition benefits per current program rules.

blocks.title: Redeem
blocks.body: Points redeem for stays across the IHG One Rewards portfolio, including EVEN Hotels, subject to availability and current redemption charts.

blocks.title: Elite Recognition
blocks.body: Elite status recognition (upgrades, late checkout, lounge access where offered) applies per property capability—delivery varies by hotel.

blocks.title: Ecosystem
blocks.body: IHG One Rewards partnerships, co-branded cards, and bonus campaigns expand the loyalty halo; EVEN Hotels stays remain the property-level earn/redeem node.

blocks.title: Owner Lens
blocks.body: IHG One Rewards drives distribution and repeat demand but adds loyalty chargebacks and program economics. Underwrite net contribution after loyalty—not membership vanity metrics.

blocks.title: P&L Implications
blocks.body: Loyalty assessments and program contribution affect net rooms revenue. Use current agreement exhibits; do not invent undisclosed rates.

blocks.title: Operating Implications
blocks.body: Front desk and systems must support IHG One Rewards enrollment, Elite recognition, and redemption stays without erasing the brand's guest experience.

blocks.title: Systems Implications
blocks.body: Parent property and reservation systems integration is required for IHG One Rewards participation—budget cutover and training in the conversion plan.

blocks.title: Repeat Guest Capture
blocks.body: IHG One Rewards earn and recognition support repeat EVEN stays when the hotel already delivers the brand promise—membership alone does not replace product fit.

blocks.title: Direct Channel & Member Pricing
blocks.body: IHG One Rewards member rates and IHG direct paths help EVEN defend contribution versus high-commission intermediaries; confirm current rate rules before IC.

blocks.title: Elite Member Value
blocks.body: Elite recognition benefits support contribution at EVEN where the property can deliver upgrades and service standards; capability still varies by asset.

blocks.title: Cross-Brand Traveler Flow
blocks.body: One Rewards recognition across IHG sister brands matters for multi-brand itineraries—EVEN is the brand-specific earn/redeem node inside that network.

blocks.title: Partner & Payment Scale
blocks.body: IHG One Rewards partnerships and bonus campaigns expand acquisition; underwrite hotel-level net contribution after loyalty assessments—not headline membership counts.

blocks.title: Corporate & Negotiated Demand
blocks.body: IHG account and negotiated transient patterns can support midweek compression where corporate mix fits EVEN—validate against this hotel's source markets.

blocks.title: To Join
blocks.body: EVEN Hotels application, royalty, program fees, and One Rewards assessments — confirm current IHG disclosure exhibits. Amounts are not staged without a verified disclosure.

blocks.title: To Operate
blocks.body: Steady-state royalty, program contribution, and IHG One Rewards loyalty assessments — confirm definitions, bases, and current percentages in the live disclosure exhibit for EVEN Hotels. Do not underwrite from peer rumor.

blocks.title: When Things Change
blocks.body: Renewal PIP; conversion PIP revisions; transfer / change-of-ownership fees; termination-related obligations; owner-funded reserves—triggered at renewal, repositioning, or exit. Confirm liquidated damages and transfer mechanics in the current agreement.

blocks.title: Fee Variability
blocks.body: Initial vs conversion paths differ; program contribution and loyalty assessments may change by year under agreement terms. Lock the fee exhibit before IC—never extrapolate from a peer hotel's rumor. Geography note: Confirm current IHG development / franchise disclosure for EVEN Hotels

blocks.title: Why Value Is Strongest in These Scenarios
blocks.body:
Keep Local Product Intent—Add IHG One Rewards: retain EVEN Hotels's brand promise while accessing loyalty earn/redeem and parent commercial systems a standalone hotel cannot buy alone.
Wellness-forward select-service: fitness-centric public space, healthier F&B cues, and efficient rooms for travelers who prioritize wellbeing routines on the road.
Sibling Clarity: diligence fit versus same-parent peers before assuming identical owner use case or fee path.
Operator & Owner Fit: strongest when the asset can deliver the brand's guest promise with QA discipline—weakest when sponsors want the flag without the product investment.
Disclosure Discipline: model economics only from current fee exhibits—Factory 2.0 does not invent undisclosed percentages.

blocks.title: Urban Wellness Select-Service
blocks.body: City sites where fitness-forward public space and healthier stay cues can differentiate versus standard select-service competitors.

blocks.title: Corporate Corridor Health Positioning
blocks.body: Midweek corporate corridors where wellness amenities support rate and loyalty mix—validate that the fitness product is real, not cosmetic.

blocks.title: Conversion Into Wellness Lifestyle
blocks.body: Select-service conversions that can fund credible fitness and F&B upgrades without jumping to full-service spa economics.

before.body: EVEN Hotels is a wellness-led upscale select / lifestyle hotel brand within IHG Hotels & Resorts. For owners, the affiliation case is wellness positioning, conversion or new-build prototype fit, IHG distribution and loyalty, operating model implications, and market demand for wellness-minded travelers. It should be evaluated on its own guest promise and operating implications, not as a generic parent-brand substitute or an interchangeable peer among Holiday Inn Express, avid hotels, voco, Hotel Indigo.
